en.headline: Police smash hotel SIM-box phone-scam den, arrest two men
en.dek: Commercial Crime Bureau officers linked a rented hotel room to at least five late-August cases involving about HK$600,000, the largest a HK$380,000 loss by a retiree.
body: Police said two local men, aged 26 and 38, were arrested in a hotel room on 28 August after officers found what they described as a SIM-box phone-scam control centre. The pair were held on suspicion of conspiracy to defraud and possessing dangerous drugs.

Commercial Crime Bureau chief inspector Wong Yuk-yan said at a briefing that the pair were linked to at least five phone-scam reports in late August involving about HK$600,000. The largest single loss was about HK$380,000, suffered by a retiree.

Investigators said the men had bought registered mobile SIM cards from other people and used those numbers to call victims, posing as staff from insurers or payment platforms. Callers claimed the victim had taken out an insurance service and was late on payment, and would be charged unless the service was cancelled. Victims were then talked through online banking screens and told to enter what were described as verification codes, which police said were in fact transfer amounts.

In the room, officers seized a device that can hold multiple SIM cards, commonly called a SIM box or cat pool, along with three mobile phones, two computers and 53 SIM cards. They also seized about one gram of suspected ice and a drug-taking implement. Police said the group may also have sent text messages posing as online shops or courier firms.

zh.headline: 警搗酒店「貓池」電騙中心拘兩男 涉款約60萬
zh.dek: 商業罪案調查科指酒店房間興8月下旬最少5宗電話騙案有關，最大一宗退休人士損失約38萬元。
body: 警方表示，商業罪案調查科人員8月28日在一酒店房間拘捕兩名分別26歲及38歲的本地男子，檢獲用作電話騙案擊控中心的設備，兩人涉嫌串謀詐騙及管有危險藥物。
商業罪案調查科訝騙組總督察王玉欣交代案情，指兩人興8月下旬最少5宗電話騙案有關，涉款約60萬元，單宗最大損失約38萬元，受害人為一名退休人士。
調查指兩人向不同人士購買已實名登記的流動電話卡，再用這些號碼致電受害人，訝稱來自保險公司或支付平台，指對方已開通保險服務但遲交款項，若不取消服務便會被扣帳。受害人其後按指示在網上銀行介面輸入聲稱是驗證碼的數字，警方指該些數字實際是轉帳金額。
行動中檢獲一部可同時插入多張電話卡、俗稱「貓池」的裝置、3部手提電話、2部電腦及53張電話卡，另檢獲約1克懸疑冰毒及吸食工具。警方亦相信集團曾向市民發送短訊，冒充網上購物平台或速遞公司。
